scope: Owned loopback peer/MCP listeners, persistent per-source sync loops and opt-in scheduler in one local host; no installed service, physical network activation or native model calls.

contract.first_control_observation: Before first scheduler watch/claim, then normally every second
drain_order: wait owned scheduler while MCP, peer and sync stay available
contract.sync_outage: Component error/backoff; does not cancel local in-flight task

red_boundary_reproduction.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="replaced runtime lock|durable startup drain" tests/noderuntimetest.mjs tests/schedulertest.mjs

validation.counts_note: Final 7 node tests + 3 composition tests + 24 unchanged scheduler regression cases from the earlier 32-unit pass. Repeated cases are not added. Shared lifecycle factory was unchanged after that full pass.

regressions.name: durable startup drain
regressions.before: Used synthetic quota 1 instead of expected 0 because first control observation waited for the timer.
regressions.after: Immediate observation before watch; zero launches and used quota 0, observed_revision 2.

regressions.name: replaced runtime lock
regressions.before: NODE_RUNTIME_LOCK_CHANGED thrown and foreign lock retained, but ended_at was already written.
regressions.after: Verify lock before finish; foreign bytes retained, ended_at null, executor_stop_confirmed false.

observed: Separate actual CLI and scoped MCP bridge read local overview; durable drain is idempotent and host closes normally.
Two real loopback hosts synchronize both directions; source shutdown leaves receiver MCP available; restart catches up without receiver restart or replica duplication.
Occupied external MCP port remains active after partial host startup failure; only owned peer listener closes.
Offline peer while synthetic Windows Job runs: host drain keeps MCP alive, completes one permit, leaves next assignment waiting and then closes components.
Host cancel reaches actual Windows Job and records separate node and scheduler stopped instances without refunding consumed permit.
Public bind, mismatched credential source and second host startup are rejected.
engineering_notes: Initial CI edit anchor did not match the unquoted YAML step; package and CI edits were subsequently applied using the observed file. No product guard was weakened.
